author: Sulerpy
title: Hiring character concept artist for original male VTuber
content:
Looking for a character concept artist/designer to create an original male VTuber character from scratch.

 I don’t have a finished costume, world, visual theme, or character design that I want someone to simply illustrate.

I’m looking for the opposite: an artist whose imagination could take the name “Sulerpy” and discover something I would never have designed on my own.

 I want to give the artist substantial creative freedom playful, strange, elegant, energetic, surreal, unexpected, or a direction I haven’t even imagined yet.

Looking for strong visual development + concept exploration, not just a finished illustration.

Budget: up to $3K depending on scope/experience. Must be open to full IP/copyright transfer for the final design.

No need to follow me to reach out.
Please DM me
or
email me at: sulerpy@yahoo.com
 with your portfolio + rates.
